deadline_text_verbatim: the program opening at 16:00 on the 1st of June and it will close at 23:59 on the 12th of July 2026, Turkish time
limitations: Bound to the CURRENT cycle (2026-2027, the intake beginning weeks after this retrieval), and the window has already closed - METU's own announcements page confirms closure on 13/07/2026. Both facts are true simultaneously; the cycle is current and the deadline is past. Note also that cycle_year here follows the corpus convention of entry year, so 2026 means the 2026-2027 Turkish academic year, NOT a 2027 UK-style entry.

deadline_text_verbatim: An additional application period will be opened for international student applications to the undergraduate programs at ODTÜ Ankara Campus for the 2026–2027 academic year.
limitations: LIVE AND UNDATED. Announced 19/08/2026, two days before this retrieval, and the announcement text as extracted states that an additional period WILL be opened without giving its dates. deadline_date is null because no date was published in the text retrieved, not because none exists. This is the highest-urgency row in the corpus: a Turkish or international student who missed the 12 July close has a second chance right now and ORYN cannot tell them when it ends. Re-fetch the individual announcement page for the dates before the window closes.

deadline_text_verbatim: submit and finalize the online application between June 1 and July 12, 2026, even if you do not yet have your final A-level results
limitations: A SECOND, LATER deadline for the same application: A-level applicants receive 'Admission deferral' status and their final scores are due in August 2026, with the evaluation completed only then. deadline_date is null because the source gives a MONTH, not a day, and synthesising one would be inventing the part that was never published. Two-stage deadlines of this shape have no representation in university_deadlines at all - the table can hold the application close but not the conditional document deadline that follows it.

deadline_text_verbatim: the closing date for International applications is Friday 26 June 2026
source_authority_note: tudublin.ie has no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix so looksOfficial() in lib/acquisition/source-authority.ts rejects it, exactly as it rejects tcd.ie. This is TU Dublin's own site publishing TU Dublin's own deadline. Needs the institution official-domain provenance mechanism, piece (A) in source-authority-gap.md.
limitations: The page adds that 'application deadlines may vary by course, and some courses may close early if they reach capacity', so this is a ceiling rather than a guarantee - a rolling-capacity close is a deadline the table cannot express and that no student can plan against precisely.

deadline_text_verbatim: The closing date for courses starting in September 2025 is Friday 27 June 2025
limitations: Retained deliberately. Held beside DL-9110 it shows TU Dublin's international close landing on the last Friday of June in two consecutive cycles - which is a PATTERN, not a rule, and must not be projected into 2027. Recording both is what makes the pattern visible without anyone acting on it.

deadline_text_verbatim: The standard closing date to apply is February 1st.
source_authority_note: tudublin.ie fails looksOfficial(). Separately, this is a restatement of a CAO platform-wide deadline; per coordination DECISION 1, CAO itself is the primary authority for it, and cao.ie also fails the gate. Two independent reasons this row cannot be ingested today.
limitations: YEAR-LESS DEADLINE, the archetype the recurrence field exists for. deadline_date is null and no year has been synthesised. CAO's own dated page was sought at cao.ie/index.php?page=keydates and page=importantdates on 2026-08-21; the first returned CAO's own 'page does not exist' error and the second exposed only navigation links, so the authoritative dated version could NOT be retrieved and the year remains genuinely unresolved rather than merely unlooked-for.

deadline_text_verbatim: 1 July – Final Change of Mind deadline
source_authority_note: tudublin.ie fails looksOfficial(); CAO restatement. See DL-9112.
limitations: Year-less. Irish 'Change of Mind' has no UCAS equivalent - it lets an applicant reorder or replace course choices after the close, so it is a real, actionable student deadline that a UK-shaped deadline taxonomy has no type for. Filed as deadline_type application for want of a better one.

deadline_text_verbatim: Applications for undergraduate courses commencing in September 2026 are now open. Applications will close in June 2026.
limitations: MONTH ONLY. 'Applications will close in June 2026' names a month and a year but no day, so deadline_date stays null. DL-9110 gives the precise date (Friday 26 June 2026) from a different TU Dublin page, so the two are consistent and the precise row should be preferred. Kept because the imprecise page is the one a student following the CAO route lands on, and because it demonstrates a third distinct date-precision level in one institution: exact day, month-only, and year-less.
